integrity: Exact analytic proof with reproduced symbolic identities and numerical consistency checks; no exhaustive computational certification; source publication date verified from the original arXiv first submission.
scientific_limitations: Only even integer kinetic exponents at least four and compact oval energies are covered.
A nonempty finite set of periodic-cylinder energies is established; neither its exact count nor uniqueness is asserted.
Unbounded-level trajectories and perturbation robustness are not classified.
A relevant 2019 general period-function article was only partially accessible, leaving bibliographic priority risk.
Numerical checker examples do not replace proofs of asymptotic or infinite statements.
title: Periodic cylinders and two-end algebraic period laws in even-kinetic skew flows
